human_priority: Prioritize the deadline with fewer complete pairs.
source_selection_basis: remaining formation work and time feasibility only; no induction or repair outcome selection
admission_rule: summary-1 full endpoint then immediate full 80-cell assay; do not wait for all three endpoints; raw-1 next if time/budget fit and reference-2 last
per_source_schedule_binding: full 80-cell assignment frozen before that source's first repair response
source_completion_required: all ten main episodes plus assigned warmups and immutable role-isolated endpoint binding
capability: reuse exact verified unchanged-interface wave-1 six-case result with immutable provenance; no silent reclassification or extra gate search
cutoff_check: immediately before physical dispatch, including after pacing wait; queued work is not exempt
in_flight_policy: drain safely; no blind termination, reservation release, or automatic ambiguous retry
late_response_policy: preserve as post-freeze observation and accounting, not silent primary inclusion
missing_outcome_policy: unknown in stated assigned denominator, never rejection; distinguish pending, partial, cutoff-censored and deferred
budget_policy: existing shared V3, aggregate recovery and lifetime caps remain; no per-wave reset; formation requests additional to 240 research judgments
concurrency_policy: one dispatcher/shared pacing and accounting; maximum three in-flight calls; serial causal trajectories
claim_label: deadline-limited exploratory policy-violation recovery after V3 histories; original 480-cell study amended and incomplete
